overview_description.description: Flower is an open-source framework for training AI on distributed data using federated learning. Companies like Banking Circle, Nokia, Porsche, and Brave use Flower to easily improve their AI models on sensitive data that is distributed across organizational silos or user devices. Almost all AI today is based on centralized public data — a small fraction of the data we have; we believe that training on orders of magnitude more data will unlock the next leaps in AI.

about_short_description.short_description: Flower is a federated learning, analytics, and evaluation platform.

product.name: Flower Framework
product.description: A framework for building, simulating, and deploying federated learning systems compatible with various ML frameworks and programming languages.

product.name: Flower Intelligence
product.description: An on-device AI platform with optional confidential remote compute for privacy-preserving federated learning applications.

product.name: Flower Datasets
product.description: A library for creating and partitioning datasets tailored for federated learning, evaluation, and analytics.

product.name: Flower Baselines
product.description: A collection of reproducible federated learning research results and example projects for various ML frameworks and scenarios.

product.name: Flower Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise-grade federated AI deployment platform with security, scalability, compliance, and support features.
